title: The Avocados That May Save Us from a Guacamole Apocalypse
gist: The Hass avocado, the world's dominant cultivar, is a clone of a single 1926 tree grafted worldwide, so every commercial fruit is genetically near-identical and one pathogen or climate shock could take out whole orchards at once. Researchers led by archaeobotanist Kevin Wann catalogued Central America's local avocado diversity in 2024 as the genetic insurance policy for a crop whose prices keep climbing from Los Angeles to Beijing.

insights.so_what: A globally traded soft commodity resting on one 1926 genotype is a single-point-of-failure supply chain, not a diversified one.
